description: CertPool is documented as 'an unordered collection' but derives PartialEq which compares internal Vec element-by-element. Two pools with the same certs in different insertion order are not equal. Fix: drop PartialEq/Eq derives, or implement manually with order-insensitive comparison. File: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs line 55.
title: path-builder: CertPool derives order-sensitive PartialEq but semantics are bag
